params.original_tags: Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing, no lyrics. Age-of-sail chiptune. 8-bit console sound playing a sea shanty and a hornpipe: a square-wave lead that phrases like a fife or a tin whistle, pulse-wave chords pumping like a concertina, a triangle-wave bass walking like a tuba, noise-channel snare and a wooden-sounding drum. 6/8 jig lilt or a brisk 2/4 hornpipe, a harbour, sailors hauling rope, tall ships. Crunchy retro chip timbres, no modern synth pads, no orchestra. Background music for the build phase of a cheerful castle board game: the player stacks painted wooden wall pieces on a tile board, friendly and quick, sunlit toy fortress by the sea. Tempo: 108 BPM. Mood: calm, bouncy, curious, light. Arrangement: a steady loop of a catchy eight-bar melody with a second eight bars that answers it, a light counter-melody, no big build-up, no breakdown, no ending, constant energy so it loops. About 90 seconds long.
